tools.name: geocodio_geocode_address
tools.description: Forward geocoding: turn one address into coordinates and standard address parts. Pass q, or the parts (street, city, state_province, postal_code). Geocodio REST: GET /geocode.

tools.name: geocodio_geocode_batch
tools.description: Batch forward geocoding for up to 1000 addresses in one call. Geocodio REST: POST /geocode with a JSON array. Each address and each field is one lookup.

tools.name: geocodio_reverse_coordinates
tools.description: Reverse geocoding: turn one latitude and longitude into the nearest address. Geocodio REST: GET /reverse.

tools.name: geocodio_reverse_batch
tools.description: Batch reverse geocoding for up to 1000 'lat,lng' strings in one call. Geocodio REST: POST /reverse with a JSON array.

tools.name: geocodio_parse_address
tools.description: Split one free-form address into its components (street, city, state, zip). Geocodio REST: GET /parse.

tools.name: geocodio_distance_from_origin
tools.description: Distance and drive time from one origin to up to many destinations. Addresses or 'lat,lng' strings work. Geocodio REST: GET /distance.

tools.name: geocodio_distance_matrix
tools.description: Distances between many origins and many destinations, or one-to-one pairs. Geocodio REST: POST /distance-matrix. Each origin-destination pair is one lookup.

tools.name: geocodio_list_spreadsheets
tools.description: Show the geocoding lists (uploaded spreadsheets) on the account, one page at a time. Geocodio REST: GET /lists. Needs a key with list access.

tools.name: geocodio_get_list_status
tools.description: Show the processing status of one geocoding list (WAITING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED or FAILED). Geocodio REST: GET /lists/{id}.

tools.name: geocodio_download_list_results
tools.description: Download the results of a COMPLETED geocoding list as CSV text. Geocodio REST: GET /lists/{id}/download. Large lists can exceed the result cap.

tools.name: geocodio_delete_list
tools.description: Delete one geocoding list and its results from the account. This cannot be undone. Geocodio REST: DELETE /lists/{id}.
